## Summary

Describe the observed problem and the smallest change that addresses it.

## Evidence and verification

List the evidence used and the exact validation commands run.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the stated scope.
- [ ] Codex and Claude Code manifests remain compatible and version-aligned.
- [ ] Required references, templates, validators, tests, README, and changelog are consistent.
- [ ] No network access, MCP server, lifecycle hook, background process, or runtime dependency was added without explicit justification.
- [ ] Package tests, release tests, and applicable strict platform validation pass.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, local caches, or generated release artifacts are included.
